payload.title: Existence of no-signalling measurement-dependent local deterministic CHSH models
payload.model: 16 deterministic local strategies lambda=(A0,A1,B0,B1), each component ±1; setting pair X=(a,b) uniform.

results.restricted_four_state_model: No-signalling maximum CHSH=2. Earlier apparent violations had signalling marginals.
results.general_16_strategy_model: Linear program with normalization, positivity and no-signalling constraints admits PR-box correlations with CHSH=4.

payload.interpretation: Mathematical existence construction only. CHSH=4 is the algebraic PR-box limit, not a quantum prediction or physical mechanism.
